title: 3D Depth Button
summary: A button with a visible extruded side.
description: A button with a visible extruded side.
accessibility_notes: 3D motion is a common trigger for vestibular discomfort — keep rotations small and stop them under prefers-reduced-motion.
ai_usage: Tactile primary actions. The press travel must equal the shadow height exactly so the button meets its own base at the bottom of the press.
source:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
  <title>3D Depth Button</title>
  <script type="application/json" id="effect-meta">
  {
    "id": "hover-3d-button-depth",
    "title": "3D Depth Button",
    "summary": "A button with a visible extruded side.",
    "description": "A button with a visible extruded side.",
    "theme": "3d-transforms",
    "categories": ["3d", "transform"],
    "tags": ["3d", "transform", "button", "extrude", "press", "depth"],
    "tech": ["css"],
    "era": "2020s",
    "difficulty": "advanced",
    "dependencies": [],
    "browser_support": "All modern browsers (Chromium, Firefox, Safari).",
    "performance_notes": "Lightweight — composited transform/opacity work only.",
    "accessibility_notes": "3D motion is a common trigger for vestibular discomfort — keep rotations small and stop them under prefers-reduced-motion.",
    "customization": [
      { "name": "--h", "description": "Extrusion height", "default": "8px" }
    ],
    "variations": ["Retune through the custom properties", "Add a reduced-motion static variant"],
    "ai_usage": "Tactile primary actions. The press travel must equal the shadow height exactly so the button meets its own base at the bottom of the press."
  }
  </script>
  <style>
    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
    html, body { height: 100%; margin: 0; }
    body { display: grid; place-items: center; background: #0b0d12; color: #e7ebf3;
      font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif; overflow: hidden; }
    .fx { position: relative; padding: .9rem 2rem; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: #7c5cff; color: #fff;
      font: inherit; font-weight: 800; cursor: pointer; transform-style: preserve-3d;
      box-shadow: 0 8px 0 #4c1d95; transition: transform .12s, box-shadow .12s; }
    .fx:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 10px 0 #4c1d95; }
    .fx:active { transform: translateY(8px); box-shadow: 0 0 0 #4c1d95; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <button class="fx" type="button">Press</button>
</body>
</html>
